description: Defines the ProjectSearchFilterParams class for filtering project search results in the OrangeHRM Time module, including properties for project IDs, customer ID, employee number, and project/customer name, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProjectSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for specifying filter parameters when searching for projects within the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: getProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the array of project IDs to filter by.

methods.name: setProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the array of project IDs to filter by.

methods.name: getCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Returns the customer or project name filter.

methods.name: setCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Sets the customer or project name filter.

methods.name: getExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the list of project IDs to exclude.

methods.name: setExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the list of project IDs to exclude.
